note: Direct costs only, Boise / Treasure Valley, Idaho. No overhead, profit, contingency or trip charge is included in any line: the estimator's own calculation adds those once per job after direct costs. Labor lines are the crew cost of the incremental work while a crew is already on site. Material lines are delivered material cost. Owner reviews and adjusts; every line is a planning average, not a quote.
source: Boise / Treasure Valley planning averages, reviewed 2026-09-20
